items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. Sections 4.3(d)–(f) and 4.5 independently exclude personal effects carried in a vehicle away from the insured location, so no indemnity is payable.
Sections 4.3(e) and 5.2.5 exclude the private car and vehicle-related expenses. The insured dwelling was untouched, so the charge is not a necessary cost of repairing insured property under §7.1.1.
